sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Disables the new version dialog and the required update.
Removes banner, video, interstitial and rewarded ads. Actions that waited on a rewarded ad run immediately.
Removes the modified app warning that stops video playback.
Unlocks member-only titles, shows the account as Premium and removes the premium bundle offer. Requires a signed-in account.
